existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `Person` keeps the same identity and has no local removals or required additions, but R6 changes XML/codegen order for `active`, adds several R6-only optional data elements, widens `photo`, and changes summary behavior for `identifier` and `address`. The top migration concerns are XML sequence compatibility, R6-to-R4 data loss for new elements, and privacy/behavior changes in summary responses. Confidence is high for computable structural deltas; official narrative diffs and conversion maps would improve confidence on intent and recommended transforms.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: For R4-to-R6, check XML serializers and validators for `Person.active` order and review code generated from ordered element lists. For R6-to-R4, decide how to preserve or reject `deceased[x]`, `maritalStatus`, `communication`, and multiple `photo` values. For runtime behavior, audit `_summary` handling and any identity-management logic that used `telecom` rather than identifiers.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for local StructureDefinition changes because both assigned StructureDefinitions were present and directly compared. Confidence is medium for clinical or workflow impact because the official rendered specification pages, ballot change notes, and conversion ConceptMaps were not available. Terminology confidence is high for the unchanged administrative-gender and identity-assurance code sets inspected locally, but lower for open-ended BCP-47 language expansion behavior.
